caption: The drawing depicts two lidded, hexagonal vessels placed side by side on a plain background. Both vessels have dark blackish-brown bodies with geometric, faceted surfaces. The left vessel is shown in a three-quarters view, displaying two side handles with gold ends and a central knob handle on its lid, which is also gold in color. The lid and the upper rim of the vessel feature gold, silver, and teal decorative bands, with angular and triangular motifs, as well as a row of repeating red spirals, teal dots, and gold blossoms along the shoulder. The right vessel is shown in a partial side view, without visible handles, and exhibits similar decorative motifs but with an additional central gold ornament beneath the rim resembling a stylized shell or floral element. Both vessels rest on short, outward-flaring bases decorated with a teal band. The background is tan, and the artist’s signature, “R. Stewart,” appears in black ink at the bottom right.
title: Toleware Coal Vase
